all_inline_strings: Take the leftmost remaining disk of either selected track for each placement.
With tracks empty, reposition one of that Spirit's island Presence.
Any of its island disks may supply the placement.
Energy carries over; unused Card Plays do not.
Fast Powers must resolve in Fast or be foregone; they cannot wait until Slow.
Town plus Explorer deal 3 Damage simultaneously to land and Dahan.
Add one Blight to the previously unblighted land.
No actual one-Blight result for this previously unblighted land is supplied.
Destroy one Dahan efficiently and mark 1 Damage on the survivor.
The surviving Dahan still deals 2 counterattack Damage.
Destroying the chosen Town generates 1 Fear.
No ordinary only-Explorers Build result is supplied.
Equal Town and City counts: add one Town.
No ordinary equal Town/City counts Build result is supplied.
More Towns than Cities: add one City.
No ordinary more-Towns-than-Cities Build result is supplied.
Build adds new supply pieces and does not upgrade/remove a Town.
Explore matching lands containing a Town/City or adjacent to a Town/City/Ocean.
No ordinary Explore eligibility rule is supplied.
Add one Explorer from supply per eligible land regardless of source count.
No one-Explorer-per-land regardless of source-count rule is supplied.
Explorers do not provide Explore sources.
No rule excluding Explorers as sources is supplied.
Needing to draw from an empty Invader deck loses.
No draw-from-empty-Invader-deck defeat ruling is supplied.
Discard old Ravage; move Build to Ravage and the newly explored card to Build.
The remaining 2 generated Fear go toward the next card.
Subsequent cards resolve only at the newly current Terror Level.
The entry never resolves one disk each from A and B or where destroyed disks go.
Existing Blight quantity does not multiply the outgoing cascade.
Removing Blight never flips a Blighted card back to Healthy.
The Spirit may forego the whole Power but receives no Energy refund.
Choose Minor or Major and draw 4, reshuffling that deck's discard if needed.
Keep one in hand and put unkept cards in their deck's shared discard.
Forgotten Minor/Major goes to its deck discard; Unique goes under its panel.
No forgotten Minor/Major versus Unique destinations are supplied.
Forgetting an in-play card removes its Elements and any unused use immediately.
Already resolved effects persist for their normal duration.
Damage from normal separate Powers can combine during the turn.
Destroying a Town/City causes 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear.
Remove/Replace themselves generate no destruction Fear.
The entry does not supply an outright Destroy ignoring Health/Damage.
Terror I needs no Invaders; II no Towns/Cities; III no Cities.
The entry never states Terror I/II/III absence conditions.
Earning the final Fear card exposes Victory and wins without resolving its text.
The entry never states final-Fear-card Victory without resolving the card.
The entry never enumerates the three standard defeat routes.
Adjacent lands share a border or corner, including across boards.
Absent: neither quoted FAQ block states border/corner adjacency across boards.
Coastal means adjacent to printed Ocean; other outside cliffs do not count.
Ocean is normally not a land or in play.
A land is not adjacent to itself but is Range 0 of itself and within Range 1.
Absent: neither prose nor quotation resolves self-adjacency or self-Range 0/1.
A Spirit may wait for another's Growth result.
It is available the turn uncovered.
Absent: the entry never says Reclaim One is usable in the turn uncovered.
Forgetting an in-play card removes that card's Elements immediately.
An ordinary Range 0 target contains your Presence.
The added Town stays next turn as a board change.
The turn's Build-skip effect expires at Time Passes.
Discard played cards to personal discard and clear card Elements.
Heal survivor Damage and remove temporary effects/reminder markers.
Absent: the entry never says uncovered track Elements persist at Time Passes.
Damaged Invaders and Dahan deal their full normal Damage.
Invader total 4 becomes 1 Damage to land and separately 1 Damage to Dahan.
The Explorer retains 1 Damage, meets its 1 Health and is destroyed.
Unqualified Power Damage affects Invaders; Dahan require explicit harmful text.
Invader and Dahan supplies are unlimited; use substitutes when needed.
An ordinary Power has one target land regardless of Range or piece count.
Only explicit instructions can affect other lands, such as Push destinations.
If only two can legally be moved, move both.
Absent: the entry never resolves the two-available case as moving both.
A Growth-gained card may be played later in the same Spirit Phase.
A Fast-gained card does not automatically enter play.
There is no hand-size limit and cards may be shown to others.
Absent: the entry never gives the hand-size or hand-sharing rules.
Gain its Elements immediately when played.
Entwined gifting/transferring a Major is not Gain and requires no Forget.
A normally Forgotten Unique is under the panel and not ordinarily reclaimable.
A Slow card can be chosen and repeated in Slow.
Repeating does not grant printed card Elements again.
Its non-Repeat Energy gain still resolves.
It cannot target the original land, which is not adjacent to itself.
Entering an already-Blighted land does not destroy Presence.
Removing Blight does not restore destroyed Presence.
Explore requires sources, with the Ocean providing coastal access.
The just-added Explorer has only Explored; the card is in Build for next turn.
Each-player choices need different lands/pieces only when the card says so.
The same piece may be affected/moved by successive legal player choices.
A generic Presence/Sacred Site condition may use another Spirit's.
Explicit own-Sacred-Site counts use each Spirit's sites individually.
Remove two Invaders can remove both Cities; no Explorer-first rule applies.
Marked Damage does not reduce Health for that allowance.
The removal-choice and marked-Damage/Health rulings are absent.
At least one Dahan outnumbers zero Towns/Cities.
Zero versus zero is not outnumbering.
A one-Spirit solo game may target itself with Another Spirit.
Bonuses conditioned on actually targeting a different Spirit do not activate.
One person playing two Spirits fills two player roles and scales setup by two.
It does not get the single-Spirit self-target exception.
All requested solo targeting/bonus and multi-Spirit scaling facts are absent.
The Power user decides Power choices.
A non-land decision falls to the owner/organizer.
The requested decision-makers and consensus process are absent.
The City's 2 real Damage lets each 1-Damage nightmare use pretend-destroy it.
Carry the remaining old Blight into the new pool.
Then return and add the two Blight simultaneously.
An early Dahan Ravage attack changes timing rather than adding an extra attack.
Each Dahan still deals Ravage Damage only once.
No once-only Dahan Ravage Damage ruling appears in this entry.
There is no ordinary transfer of individual Energy or Card Plays.
Unused Card Plays cannot be saved for the next turn.
No rule that unused Card Plays expire is supplied.
Complete the start-of-phase Blighted effect tree and check outcomes before Fear.
No action-tree outcome-check ruling for the start-of-phase effect is supplied.
No ruling that the last-Presence loss is resolved before Fear is supplied.
A Spirit cannot choose a track disk to reveal a benefit.
Put the destroyed island disk beside the island, not back on its panel.
No destination for the destroyed disk is supplied.
Unless explicitly specified otherwise, it costs no Energy or Card Play.
No ordinary Innate Energy/Card Play cost is supplied.
Innates are automatically available each turn when their requirements are met.
No rule that eligible Innates are available each turn is supplied.
No second use is granted by paying the printed Energy cost again.
An ordinary Repeat need not keep the original land.
No ruling that the ordinary Repeat may change its target land is supplied.
Invaders deal 3 Damage to land, causing one Blight.
No calculated 3 land Damage or one-Blight result is supplied.
Concealing Shadows prevents Dahan Damage only; both Dahan survive healthy.
They can destroy both Town and Explorer with excess unused.
No ruling that both Town and Explorer can be destroyed is supplied.
This Ravage generates 1 Fear from the Town.
Concealing Shadows also does not prevent that non-Ravage Damage.
The given internal Range 1 with A's +2 reaches Range 3 from B's Presence.
Foregoing its text does not make it immediately leave play.
Normally discard it at Time Passes and lose its Elements then.
Defend 3 applies to each Ravage for the whole turn and is not expended.
Each of the two Ravages deals 1 Damage to land and separately 1 to the Dahan.
Without permission for more, choose one whole Growth option.
Do not combine actions from different options or choose multiple options.
Perform all possible instructions in the selected option.
Both the Presence land A and adjacent B are legal targets.
There is no default per-land stacking cap for Invaders, Dahan or Presence.
Choose the or branch before resolving either option.
Drawing/inspecting the Major cards already begins the Major-gain option.
It cannot inspect that draw and then switch to the 2 Fear option.
Normal income may not be taken before finishing Growth.
Actual normal card play/payment may not precede Growth.
The later normal Power adds Defend1, not2, excluding earlier Defend.
Setup Blight does not trigger the normal cascade rule.
No Invader action is taken for a space with no Invader Card.
Ordinary Power Damage may be freely divided among Invaders in the target land.
The Repeat resolves Elemental Boon’s explicit Element-grant effect again.
States that positive Dahan outnumber zero buildings.
States zero versus zero is not outnumbering, identifying strict inequality.
City gives 5 Fear and no Push.
